seo.description: Design, launch and evolve digital public services on a shared low-code foundation. Softcom works with Kitsoft to implement Liquio for ministries, departments and agencies.

hero.title: Public services, built to work together.
hero.text: Design, launch and evolve digital public services on a shared low-code foundation. Softcom works with Kitsoft to implement Liquio for ministries, departments and agencies, connecting service delivery with the systems and workflows behind it.

figures.label: Liquio / 01
figures.title: One foundation. Services across departments.
figures.caption: Shared platform capabilities connect the public-facing service with the work behind it.

image.alt: Conceptual diagram connecting citizens, businesses and public-service teams to Liquio

blocks.title: Build beyond the online form.
blocks.text: A digital service needs the application, information and institutional work behind it to connect. Liquio provides tools for building services and integrating government systems, with less manual coding.

points.title: Design the service
points.text: Use the service builder to create digital services around an institution’s requirements, reusing platform components across applications.

points.title: Connect the information
points.text: Bring registers, datasets and existing systems into the service through APIs. Put the information required for delivery within reach of the teams and processes that need it.

points.title: Evolve the operation
points.text: Update services as rules and processes change. A shared platform allows teams to develop services in parallel and build on work already done.

blocks.title: From application to completed service.
blocks.text: Shape the journey around what citizens and businesses need, and what the institution must do to serve them. Connect information capture, checks, reviews and service delivery in one designed workflow.

figures.label: Liquio / 02
figures.title: Connect every stage of a public service.
figures.caption: An illustrative application journey, configured around the institution’s requirements.

image.alt: Four-step public service journey from apply and check to review and deliver

blocks.title: Kitsoft’s platform. Softcom’s local delivery.
blocks.text: Softcom brings the service context, implementation and integration expertise needed to put Liquio to work for local institutions.

points.title: Understand the service
points.text: Work through the institution’s mandate, service requirements, existing systems and the needs of its users.

points.title: Configure and connect
points.text: Translate those requirements into services and workflows, integrating the records and systems the service depends on.

points.title: Prepare for use
points.text: Support deployment, team readiness and adoption, with responsibilities and ongoing support defined around the engagement.

blocks.title: A foundation your institution can build on.
blocks.text: Liquio’s open-source Community Edition, documentation and training options support institutions that want to retain the ability to develop and maintain their services with their chosen teams.

audience.title: Which public service should work better?
audience.text: For ministries, departments, agencies and governments developing individual services or a shared digital-service platform.
audience.closing: Tell us what your institution needs to deliver and the systems it must work with.
